## Available product
- REVERSE M13 Mechanism Studio 2D: https://dawn-mouse-7a3c.ing-simonelli-leonardo.workers.dev/en/reverse-m13-2d.html — EUR 19.99 one-time licence. Target trajectory by sketch/CSV, planar mechanism concept exploration. Not guaranteed to solve every curve. Stripe checkout.

## Web app under testing
- Scadenze Studio V3: https://dawn-mouse-7a3c.ing-simonelli-leonardo.workers.dev/en/scadenze-studio.html — deadline planning, documents, up to six professionals. 7-day trial then EUR 1.99 plus VAT monthly. Gmail automation is being tested; do not rely on it for critical deadlines.
